name: Afternoon Game Shows
vibe:
Weekday-afternoon background TV, like daytime game shows (The Price Is Right).
Lean-back, low-stakes, episodic, fine to half-watch while working.
Good: full episodes of game shows, competitions, cooking, home/restoration/making,
chill documentaries, travel, light comedy, panel shows.
Avoid: news, politics, outrage/drama, true crime, anything that needs close attention,
clickbait reaction videos, clips and highlight reels, music videos, multi-hour livestream VODs.
